crossRefs.note: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”
“Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
for my eyes have seen your salvation,

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”
translations.bsb: Then Israel said to Joseph, “Finally I can die, now that I have seen your face and know that you are still alive!”
translations.kjv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, because thou art yet alive.
translations.asv: And Israel said unto Joseph, Now let me die, since I have seen thy face, that thou art yet alive.
